design: Rank3 coefficient ridge prediction from receiver concatenated normalized MLP contexts10-17. Eight discovery items per family/form; centered linear kernel divided by its discovery mean diagonal. Fixed ridge alpha1; no tuning. Oracle rank3 and mean8 controls; shuffled-label control rotates discovery item labels by4.
limitations: Retrospective evaluation on already-observed fresh panel. Uses receiver full native states and known template/family, not end-to-end language model. Oracle coefficients evaluation-only. Fixed regularization may underfit.
